sloka: तौ प्रयान्तौ महावीर्यौ दिव्यम् त्रिपथगाम् नदीम् ।ददृशा ते ततः तत्र सरय्वाः संगमे शुभे ॥१-२३-५॥
transliteration: tau prayāntau mahāvīryau divyam tripathagām nadīm ।dadṛśā te tataḥ tatra sarayvāḥ saṁgame śubhe ॥1-23-5॥

translations.english: Thereafter, having gone a little further both the heroic brothers looked at the confluence of holy Sarayu with divine Ganga divided into three branches.
